uniform_random.description: Guess uniformly among 65 characters -- the absolute floor.

unigram_frequency.description: Always predict the marginal character distribution, ignoring context entirely. Any model that does not beat this has learned nothing about language.

overfitting.verdict: Train and validation loss first separate by more than 0.05 nats at step 125. Beyond that the model is spending capacity memorising rather than generalising.
